author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: This parser reads Synology DSM sign-in lines from Log Center, sent in BSD (RFC 3164) syslog format to the data collector. Sign-in successes and failures go to Auth, and every other line is left to the parsers already in the tenant.
notes:
Setup:
- In Log Center > Log Sending, send to the data collector in BSD (RFC 3164) format and include the Connection category.

Field mapping:
- DSM sign-in successes and failures go to Auth; every other line is left to the parsers already in the tenant.

Time:
- The BSD syslog time has no year or zone and is read as UTC.

Sources and licenses:
- Synology doesn't publish its log messages, so this entry covers only the sign-in lines shown in Synology's failed login article and in public third-party guides (linked).

Testing:
- Passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13.

Known gaps:
- Other admin and security events aren't covered.
- Check a few of your own lines with Parse Message first.
